title: I was hopeful this vacuum would be perfect, but...
text: I was hopeful this vacuum would be perfect, but.... I needed something to replace my uber-cheap corded stick vacuum from eight years ago that vacuumed like a champ right until the very end. I loved that thing. Based on the stellar reviews this received, I thought this cordless model from Orfeld was the answer. Pricey (comparatively), but I figured that would be an ok trade-off for being cordless. I used it no more than three or four times on LVT flooring and could only get it to suck up the occasional tuft of cat fur. Dropped kitten kibble or coffee beans? Not a chance. My mother was visiting the other day and tried to use it. She told me that it didn't do anything, so she checked to make sure it was clean inside even though it looks brand new. I told her I cleaned it after the last time I tried to get it to work. Her response: just throw it away and buy another corded one like your last one. Today, the $33 corded one arrived (a different brand) and sucked up everything like a champ. I wish I hadn't wasted my money. Hopefully, mine was the only dud and everyone else has a great experience with theirs.
